# Sequence

Show the messages that participants exchange over time.

===! "Diagram"

    ```mermaid
    ---
    config:
      theme: default
      look: classic
    ---
    sequenceDiagram
      autonumber
      actor Customer
      participant Web as Web app
      participant API as API gateway
      participant Bank
      Customer->>Web: Place order
      Web->>API: POST /orders
      activate API
      API->>Bank: Authorize payment
      Bank-->>API: Approved
      API-->>Web: 201 Created
      deactivate API
      Web-->>Customer: Order confirmed
      Note over Customer,Bank: One order, one transaction
    ```
